title: Whip Tilt
description: A whip tilt is a violent, motion-blurred vertical rotation of the camera, then a hard stop. It is the up-or-down cousin of a whip pan: shock through speed, not through traveling the support.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Vertical shock instead of a horizontal whip. A body hits the floor, a face is found in a tree, a sign slams down from sky.
The middle of the move should be unreadable on purpose. It is the wrong tool for a slow reveal of a tower, and the wrong tool if you needed the camera to fall with a body.
Blurred pitch is not a crane collapse.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Rotate on the horizontal axis past blur, then hard-stop on a composed frame. Match blur if you cut inside it.
Keep the tripod planted so you do not add a drop. Prompt a violent vertical whip tilt, the frame ripping up or down with motion blur, then a hard stop.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it for vertical shock instead of a horizontal whip. Concrete beat: from a screaming mouth down onto the weapon that caused it.
Do not use it to measure a building.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Evil Dead throws the camera through violent vertical reorientations as shock grammar. Crank uses similar speed as body panic.
These are references for blur-and-stop, not for copying specific gags.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a Whip Pan or a fast Tilt Down that remains readable. The tell is horizontal streaks, or a clear building in the middle of the move.
The fix: vertical blur, planted support, sharp landing.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Whip Tilt in film?
It is a tilt so fast that the image streaks vertically, then a hard stop on a new high or low composition.
Whip Tilt vs Whip Pan
Whip pan blurs horizontally by yawing. Whip tilt blurs vertically by pitching. Both plant the support and hide the middle in speed.
When should I use Whip Tilt?
When the shock is above or below, not beside. Do not use it for a gentle height reveal.
How do I prompt Whip Tilt for AI image or video?
Write extremely fast vertical tilt, heavy motion blur, hard stop on a named end frame. Specify up or down. No crane travel.
